summary: GlobalFoundries filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release from its 2026 Investor Day announcing its first-ever quarterly dividend of $0.12 per share, payable July 14, 2026 to holders of record June 24, 2026. The board also approved a new capital allocation framework targeting returning up to 50% of trailing twelve-month Non-IFRS adjusted free cash flow to shareholders via dividends and share repurchases. No financial advisor or specific repurchase program was disclosed. This is a non-event-driven capital return initiative, not tied to any special situation. Watch for future buyback execution and earnings trajectory to gauge sustainability.
